Package com.elotouch.elopay.library

Class EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elotouch.elopay.library.EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    UsbPortSwitcher
    Enclosing class:
    EloPeripheralManager
    public class EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
extends java.lang.Object
implements UsbPortSwitcher
    The USB port class to enable/disable data role and power role of USB port that on the external USB hub and these external USB hubs support hot plug.

    Including:

    - POS hub (for hand held project)

    - IO hub (for i-series project)

    - POS stand hub (for i-series project)

    - Flip stand hub (for i-series project)

      • ACTION_EXT_USB_HUB_STATE

        public static final java.lang.String ACTION_EXT_USB_HUB_STATE
        Deprecated.
        please use EloPeripheralManager.ACTION_EXT_USB_HUB_STATE

        Broadcast Action: external USB hub state change events when user hot plug the external HUB hub, This is a sticky broadcast for clients that includes external USB hub connected/disconnected state

        • device - A string value indicating device name which define as ACCESSORY_xxx in below
        • type - A int value indicating device type that define as ExtHubType.
        • EloPeripheralManager.HUB_CONNECTED boolean indicating whether USB HUB is connected or disconnected.
        See Also:

      • EXT_USER_USB_PORT1

        public static final int EXT_USER_USB_PORT1
        User USB port1: the first outer USB port that available for end user.

        POS Hub: - The type-C USB port near the power port - Not allow application to disable this TYPE-C USB port

        IO Hub: - The type-A USB port near the Ethernet port

        POS STAND with CFD: - The type-A USB port near the Ethernet port - At the up layer

        POS STAND without CFD: - The type-A USB port near the Ethernet port - At the up layer Flip STAND: - The type-A USB port near the Ethernet port - At the up layer

        See Also:

      • getFirmwareVersion

        @Nullable
public android.os.Bundle getFirmwareVersion()
        Get the firmware version of the connected external USB hub.
      • The firmware version may contains the information for these units
      • - port-A: the type-C port which is used to connected to android device
      • - port-B: the type-C port which is used to connected external monitor
      • - MCU: some external hub has MCU,it will be used to configure the external USB hub

      • The firmware units of the external USB hub:
      • - POS hub (for hand held models): port-A and port-B
      • - IO hub (for i-series and USBC models) : port-A
      • - POS stand hub with CFD (for i-series and USBC project) : port-A and MCU
      • - POS stand hub without CFD (for i-series and USBC project): port-A,port-B and MCU
      • - Flip stand hub (for i-series and USBC project) : port-A,port-B and MCU
Returns:
Bundle that contains the firmware information like as: Bundle b = new Bundle(); b.putString("port-a", portAFirmware); b.putString("port-b", portBFirmware); b.putString("mcu", mcuFirmware);

  • enableUsbPort

    public void enableUsbPort​(int port,
                          boolean enable,
                          @Nullable
                          android.os.Message onComplete)
    Request to enable/disable data role of the given USB port on the external hub.
    Parameters:
    port - is the port id that you are requesting to enable/disable, define in EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
    enable - is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.
    onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed.if onComplete is null, don't send callback message when completed. the operation Boolean result will be put in onComplete.data with Bundle: Bundle b = new Bundle(); b.putBoolean("result", success); onComplete.setData(b);

  • enableUsbPort

    public void enableUsbPort​(int port,
                          boolean enable,
                          int roleFlag,
                          @Nullable
                          android.os.Message onComplete)
    Request to enable/disable data or power role of the given USB port on the external hub. Similar to enableUsbPort(int, boolean, Message), but with the given role flag to indicate switch data or power role.
    Specified by:
    enableUsbPort in interface UsbPortSwitcher
    Parameters:
    port - is the port id that you are requesting to enable/disable, define in EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort
    enable - is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.
    roleFlag - indicate to switch data role, power role, or both, see ROLE_FLAG_XXX in UsbPortSwitcher.
    onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed.if onComplete is null, don't send callback message when completed. the operation Boolean result will be put in onComplete.data with Bundle: Bundle b = new Bundle(); b.putBoolean("result", success); onComplete.setData(b);
